metaDescription: Order custom rectangular buttons for events and branding. Contact Perfect Imprints for bulk pricing on these unique shapes.
introHtml: Rectangular buttons offer a sleek, modern alternative to standard round pins, giving your message a clean, professional edge. Whether you're promoting a safety initiative, distributing event passes, or creating branded giveaways for a trade show, the straight edges and larger surface area provide more room for logos and text. Decorate with full-color print or simple text, and choose from various sizes to fit your campaign. These buttons stand out in a crowd of circles, making your brand instantly recognizable.
heroAltText: Custom rectangular buttons with printed logos and text, arranged on a table for promotional use.
